0022600102.text: The Lakers, 1-0 and 2nd in the Pacific, host the 1-0 LA Clippers, who are 1st in the Pacific, in the second game of the Lakers' season, with the Clippers 2nd in the West and the Lakers 4th. Lakers guards and forwards Adou Thiero, Cameron Carr, Collin Sexton and Jake LaRavia are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions because of knee, oblique strain, calf and ankle issues, while the Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with the Lakers winning the last meeting 125-122 in Los Angeles on February 20, 2026.
